$comment: Card words written by the FreeTheDream project session; Cassidy to review (9 Nov 2026). The demo is a built copy in public/demos/freethedream/ (see public/demos/README.md).
title: FreeTheDream
description: A shared map of the community's projects. Explore sixteen projects, approve new ideas as the admin, and watch a project space come to life.

images.alt: The FreeTheDream demo: a round map of sixteen community projects in a yin-yang of sea and night sky, each project a labelled circle, with a project list beside it and a strip saying the data is made up.
The Suggestions panel beside the map, with five made-up project ideas waiting for review, starting with Rooftop Garden and Repair Café, each with a Follow button.
The admin Review panel beside the map, with Add to the map and Not this time buttons for suggested projects such as Repair Café and Sound Bath in the Park.
A project page for the made-up Seed Library: a sprout logo, "On the map" and "Run by Sam, Lena" labels, and editable tagline and about sections.
The project space preview: the map zoomed in on Mayhem beside a panel titled "How a project space would run", at step 4 of 14, where Ari posts a task that every member sees.
